description: Ministry of Education - The Universities Act. No. 16 of 1978 - Order Under Section 21 (Relating to the Establishment of the University of Vavuniya, Sri Lanka) revoke w.e.f. 31.07.2021 Order made Under Section 27 Published in the Gaz. Ex. No. 968/6 of March 26, 1997
